Zǒu le yí ge wǎnshàng, tā shuō jiǎo yǒudiǎn téng, wǒmen jiù zài yèshì pángbiān de kāfēitīng zuò le yíxià. Wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, bù zhīdào yào gēn tā shuō shénme. 坐了一下: V + 一下 is a short action, they sat for a little while.
我很緊張，不知道要說什麼: on a first date he is nervous and can't think what to say.
開玩笑 splits around 一個: 開了一個玩笑, she made a joke and they laughed.

text.traditional: 我的妹妹是小學生，個性很害羞。上個週末，我帶她去動物園。看到小羊的時候，她很害怕，不敢摸，一直站在我後面。後來看到別的小孩都在摸，她也去摸了一下。雖然她只摸了一下，可是回家的時候，她一直說下次還要去。

text.pinyin: Wǒ de mèimei shì xiǎoxuéshēng, gèxìng hěn hàixiū. Shàng ge zhōumò, wǒ dài tā qù dòngwùyuán. Kàndào xiǎo yáng de shíhòu, tā hěn hàipà, bù gǎn mō, yìzhí zhàn zài wǒ hòumiàn. Hòulái kàndào biéde xiǎohái dōu zài mō, tā yě qù mō le yíxià. Suīrán tā zhǐ mō le yíxià, kěshì huí jiā de shíhòu, tā yìzhí shuō xià cì hái yào qù.

When she saw the lambs she was scared, didn't dare touch them, and stayed behind me the whole time. Then she saw other kids touching them, so she went and touched one too. text.traditional:

時間：每天上午九點到晚上十點

prompt.traditional: 發燒的人看完醫生以後，應該怎麼做？

text.traditional: 我是從越南來的大學生，在台灣住了兩年了。雖然我很喜歡打籃球，可是還沒看過籃球比賽。上個星期，我的台灣同學買了兩張比賽的票，本來要跟他哥哥一起去，可是他哥哥那天剛好要上班，所以同學就送給我一張，我們一起去了。那天人很多，很熱鬧，我們看得很愉快。

text.pinyin: Wǒ shì cóng Yuènán lái de dàxuéshēng, zài Táiwān zhù le liǎng nián le. Suīrán wǒ hěn xǐhuān dǎ lánqiú, kěshì hái méi kàn guo lánqiú bǐsài. Shàng ge xīngqí, wǒ de Táiwān tóngxué mǎi le liǎng zhāng bǐsài de piào, běnlái yào gēn tā gēge yìqǐ qù, kěshì tā gēge nà tiān gānghǎo yào shàngbān, suǒyǐ tóngxué jiù sòng gěi wǒ yì zhāng, wǒmen yìqǐ qù le. choices.english: The student bought a ticket online.

text.traditional: 我們本來打算這個週末去合歡山看雪，可是前幾天下了大雨，去合歡山的路壞了，不能開車上山，所以後來決定去日月潭。我們要先坐高鐵，再搭公車去日月潭，坐公車要一個多小時。我們打算在那裡住一個晚上，星期天下午再回台北。
text.simplified: 我们本来打算这个周末去合欢山看雪，可是前几天下了大雨，去合欢山的路坏了，不能开车上山，所以后来决定去日月潭。我们要先坐高铁，再搭公车去日月潭，坐公车要一个多小时。我们打算在那里住一个晚上，星期天下午再回台北。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen běnlái dǎsuàn zhège zhōumò qù Héhuān Shān kàn xuě, kěshì qián jǐ tiān xià le dà yǔ, qù Héhuān Shān de lù huài le, bù néng kāichē shàng shān, suǒyǐ hòulái juédìng qù Rìyuè Tán. Wǒmen yào xiān zuò gāotiě, zài dā gōngchē qù Rìyuè Tán, zuò gōngchē yào yí ge duō xiǎoshí. Wǒmen dǎsuàn zài nàlǐ zhù yí ge wǎnshàng, xīngqítiān xiàwǔ zài huí Táiběi.
text.english: We had planned to go to Hehuan Mountain this weekend to see the snow, but it rained heavily a few days ago and the road to Hehuan Mountain is damaged, so cars can't drive up. In the end we decided to go to Sun Moon Lake. We'll take the high-speed rail first and then a bus, which takes a bit over an hour. We plan to stay one night there and come back to Taipei on Sunday afternoon.

prompt.english: Why did they decide to go to Sun Moon Lake in the end?

choices.english: Sun Moon Lake is close to the high-speed rail station.

choices.english: The road up Hehuan Mountain can't be used.

choices.traditional: 他們想在日月潭住一晚
choices.simplified: 他们想在日月潭住一晚

choices.english: They want to stay a night at Sun Moon Lake.

questions.why: 去合歡山的路壞了，不能開車上山，所以後來決定去日月潭: the plan changed because the mountain road can't be used. Snow was why they first wanted to go, the bus ride from the train is over an hour (not close), and staying a night is the new plan, not its reason.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 謝謝，可是我現在太緊張了，一點東西都吃不下。
lines.simplified: 谢谢，可是我现在太紧张了，一点东西都吃不下。
lines.pinyin: Xièxie, kěshì wǒ xiànzài tài jǐnzhāng le, yìdiǎn dōngxi dōu chī bú xià.
lines.english: Thanks, but I'm too nervous right now. I can't eat a thing.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你念了那麼多，一定沒問題的。不吃東西，考試的時候肚子餓了怎麼辦？
lines.simplified: 你念了那么多，一定没问题的。不吃东西，考试的时候肚子饿了怎么办？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ niàn le nàme duō, yídìng méi wèntí de. Bù chī dōngxi, kǎoshì de shíhòu dùzi è le zěnme bàn?
lines.english: You've studied so much, you'll be fine. If you don't eat, what will you do if you get hungry during the exam?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好吧，那我吃一個。
lines.simplified: 好吧，那我吃一个。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, nà wǒ chī yí ge.
lines.english: All right, I'll eat one.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼要男的快點起來？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么要男的快点起来？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme yào nán de kuài diǎn qǐlái?
prompt.english: Why does the woman tell the man to get up quickly?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她以為筆試七點半開始
choices.simplified: 她以为笔试七点半开始
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐwéi bǐshì qī diǎn bàn kāishǐ.
choices.english: She thought the exam started at half past seven.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐwéi bǐshì bā diǎn kāishǐ.
choices.english: She thought the exam started at eight.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她以為筆試九點半開始
choices.simplified: 她以为笔试九点半开始
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐwéi bǐshì jiǔ diǎn bàn kāishǐ.
choices.english: She thought the exam started at half past nine.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐwéi bǐshì shí diǎn kāishǐ.
choices.english: She thought the exam started at ten.

questions.why: 快點起來 because she thinks the exam is at eight (八點的筆試你忘了嗎？). Half past seven is the time now, ten is when it really starts, and half past nine is when he needs to be there.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的一開始為什麼不吃包子？
prompt.simplified: 男的一开始为什么不吃包子？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de yìkāishǐ wèishénme bù chī bāozi?
prompt.english: Why does the man at first not eat a bun?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng kǎo wán zài chī.
choices.english: He wants to eat after the exam.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He has no time to eat.

questions.why: 太緊張了，一點東西都吃不下: nerves leave him unable to eat (V不下). He has not eaten, and with the exam at ten he has time.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 期末考快到了，我們八個同學想找地方一起念書，圖書館的小教室坐得下嗎？
lines.simplified: 期末考快到了，我们八个同学想找地方一起念书，图书馆的小教室坐得下吗？
lines.pinyin: Qímòkǎo kuài dào le, wǒmen bā ge tóngxué xiǎng zhǎo dìfāng yìqǐ niànshū, túshūguǎn de xiǎo jiàoshì zuò de xià ma?
lines.english: Finals are coming, and eight of us want somewhere to study together. Is the library’s small room big enough?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 小教室只坐得下六個人。你們去系上的大教室吧，我明天打電話去系辦公室問問。
lines.simplified: 小教室只坐得下六个人。你们去系上的大教室吧，我明天打电话去系办公室问问。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎo jiàoshì zhǐ zuò de xià liù ge rén. Nǐmen qù xì shàng de dà jiàoshì ba, wǒ míngtiān dǎ diànhuà qù xì bàngōngshì wènwen.
lines.english: The small room only seats six. Use the department's big classroom; I'll call the department office tomorrow and ask.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 大教室常常有人用，妳快點打吧！
lines.simplified: 大教室常常有人用，你快点打吧！
lines.pinyin: Dà jiàoshì chángcháng yǒu rén yòng, nǐ kuài diǎn dǎ ba!
lines.english: The big classroom is often in use. Call them now!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 今天是星期天，辦公室沒有人啊。
lines.simplified: 今天是星期天，办公室没有人啊。
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīngqítiān, bàngōngshì méiyǒu rén a.
lines.english: It's Sunday. There's nobody in the office.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對喔，那妳明天早上一下課就打，問到了就告訴我。
lines.simplified: 对喔，那你明天早上一下课就打，问到了就告诉我。
lines.pinyin: Duì o, nà nǐ míngtiān zǎoshàng yí xiàkè jiù dǎ, wèn dào le jiù gàosu wǒ.
lines.english: Oh right. Then call tomorrow morning as soon as your class ends, and tell me what they say.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好，沒問題。
lines.simplified: 好，没问题。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, méi wèntí.
lines.english: OK, no problem.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 為什麼他們不在圖書館的小教室念書？
prompt.simplified: 为什么他们不在图书馆的小教室念书？
prompt.pinyin: Wèishénme tāmen bú zài túshūguǎn de xiǎo jiàoshì niànshū?
prompt.english: Why won't they study in the library's small room?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: The small room isn't open on Sundays.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dà jiàoshì chángcháng yǒu rén yòng.
choices.english: The big classroom is often in use.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tāmen de rén tài duō le.
choices.english: There are too many of them.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Nobody is in the office today.

questions.why: 小教室只坐得下六個人, but there are eight of them. Sunday and the empty office are about the phone call, and the busy big classroom is why he wants her to hurry.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的什麼時候會打電話？
prompt.simplified: 女的什么时候会打电话？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shénme shíhòu huì dǎ diànhuà?
prompt.english: When will the woman make the call?

questions.why: He first tells her 快點打 (call now), but it is Sunday and the office is empty, so they agree: 明天早上一下課就打, right after her class tomorrow morning.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voice message, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你好，我是你們的文法老師。你今天沒來上課，所以我打電話告訴你明天小考的事。
lines.simplified: 你好，我是你们的文法老师。你今天没来上课，所以我打电话告诉你明天小考的事。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ shì nǐmen de wénfǎ lǎoshī. Nǐ jīntiān méi lái shàngkè, suǒyǐ wǒ dǎ diànhuà gàosu nǐ míngtiān xiǎokǎo de shì.
lines.english: Hello, this is your grammar teacher. You weren't in class today, so I'm calling to tell you about tomorrow's quiz.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 小考要從第三課考到第五課，第六課下次再考。因為我們的教室明天有別的課，所以要到三樓的大教室考。
lines.simplified: 小考要从第三课考到第五课，第六课下次再考。因为我们的教室明天有别的课，所以要到三楼的大教室考。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎokǎo yào cóng dì sān kè kǎo dào dì wǔ kè, dì liù kè xià cì zài kǎo. Yīnwèi wǒmen de jiàoshì míngtiān yǒu bié de kè, suǒyǐ yào dào sān lóu de dà jiàoshì kǎo.
lines.english: The quiz covers Lessons 3 to 5; Lesson 6 will be tested next time. Because our room has another class tomorrow, we'll take it in the big classroom on the third floor.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 考完以後，請把上次的報告交給我，作文下個星期再交就可以了。
lines.simplified: 考完以后，请把上次的报告交给我，作文下个星期再交就可以了。
lines.pinyin: Kǎo wán yǐhòu, qǐng bǎ shàng cì de bàogào jiāo gěi wǒ, zuòwén xià ge xīngqí zài jiāo jiù kěyǐ le.
lines.english: After the quiz, please hand me last time's report; the composition can wait until next week.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 明天的小考一共考幾課？
prompt.simplified: 明天的小考一共考几课？
prompt.pinyin: Míngtiān de xiǎokǎo yígòng kǎo jǐ kè?
prompt.english: How many lessons does tomorrow's quiz cover?

questions.why: 從第三課考到第五課: Lessons 3, 4 and 5, three lessons. Lesson 6 is tested next time (下次再考), so it is not four.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 考完小考，這個學生要做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 考完小考，这个学生要做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Kǎo wán xiǎokǎo, zhège xuéshēng yào zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What must this student do after the quiz?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiāo yǐqián xiě hǎo de bàogào.
choices.english: Hand in the report written earlier.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qù sān lóu de jiàoshì shàngkè.
choices.english: Go to class on the third floor.

questions.why: 請把上次的報告交給我: after the quiz the student hands in the earlier report. The composition can wait until next week, and the third-floor room is where the quiz itself is.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn huà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a short talk, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 各位同學，期末考快到了。圖書館平日本來開到晚上十點，從下個星期一開始，平日會開到半夜十二點，週末還是開到晚上九點。
lines.simplified: 各位同学，期末考快到了。图书馆平日本来开到晚上十点，从下个星期一开始，平日会开到半夜十二点，周末还是开到晚上九点。
lines.pinyin: Gè wèi tóngxué, qímòkǎo kuài dào le. Túshūguǎn píngrì běnlái kāi dào wǎnshàng shí diǎn, cóng xià ge xīngqíyī kāishǐ, píngrì huì kāi dào bànyè shí'èr diǎn, zhōumò háishì kāi dào wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn.
lines.english: Students, finals are coming. On weekdays the library has closed at ten p.m.; from next Monday it will stay open until midnight on weekdays, and at weekends it still closes at nine p.m.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 平日三樓的小教室可以用到晚上十一點，坐得下六個人。想跟同學一起念書的，請先在網路上訂位。
lines.simplified: 平日三楼的小教室可以用到晚上十一点，坐得下六个人。想跟同学一起念书的，请先在网路上订位。
lines.pinyin: Píngrì sān lóu de xiǎo jiàoshì kěyǐ yòng dào wǎnshàng shíyī diǎn, zuò de xià liù ge rén. Xiǎng gēn tóngxué yìqǐ niànshū de, qǐng xiān zài wǎnglù shàng dìngwèi.
lines.english: On weekdays the small rooms on the third floor can be used until eleven p.m. and seat six. If you want to study with classmates, please book online first.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 還有，借了書的同學，請在學期結束以前把書還回來，要不然下個學期就不能再借書了。謝謝大家！
lines.simplified: 还有，借了书的同学，请在学期结束以前把书还回来，要不然下个学期就不能再借书了。谢谢大家！
lines.pinyin: Hái yǒu, jiè le shū de tóngxué, qǐng zài xuéqí jiéshù yǐqián bǎ shū huán huílái, yàobùrán xià ge xuéqí jiù bù néng zài jiè shū le. Xièxie dàjiā!
lines.english: Also, if you have borrowed books, please return them before the semester ends, or you will not be able to borrow books next semester. Thank you!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 下個星期六，圖書館開到幾點？
prompt.simplified: 下个星期六，图书馆开到几点？
prompt.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqíliù, túshūguǎn kāi dào jǐ diǎn?
prompt.english: Until what time is the library open next Saturday?

questions.why: Saturday is a weekend day: 週末還是開到晚上九點. Ten was the old weekday time, midnight the new weekday time, and eleven is when the small rooms close.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 想用三樓的小教室，要怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 想用三楼的小教室，要怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Xiǎng yòng sān lóu de xiǎo jiàoshì, yào zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What must you do to use a small room on the third floor?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiān bǎ jiè de shū huán le.

questions.why: 請先在網路上訂位: the rooms are booked online first. Six is how many a room can seat, not a requirement, and returning books is a separate request.

title.traditional: 華語文中心 語言交換
title.simplified: 华语文中心 语言交换

text.traditional:
想多練習說中文嗎？想交台灣朋友嗎？
時間：12月每個星期三 18:30–20:30
教室：華語文中心2樓（坐得下30個人）
怎麼做：一個外國學生跟一個台灣學生一起聊天，第一個小時說中文，第二個小時說外國學生自己的語言。
費用：免費
參加：請先上網留言，寫下你的名字和電話。教室坐滿了就不能再參加
華語文中心 11/20
text.simplified:
想多练习说中文吗？想交台湾朋友吗？
时间：12月每个星期三 18:30–20:30
教室：华语文中心2楼（坐得下30个人）
怎么做：一个外国学生跟一个台湾学生一起聊天，第一个小时说中文，第二个小时说外国学生自己的语言。
费用：免费
参加：请先上网留言，写下你的名字和电话。教室坐满了就不能再参加
华语文中心 11/20
text.pinyin:
Xiǎng duō liànxí shuō Zhōngwén ma? Xiǎng jiāo Táiwān péngyǒu ma?
Shíjiān: Shí'èr yuè měi ge xīngqísān shíbā diǎn sānshí dào èrshí diǎn sānshí
Jiàoshì: Huáyǔwén zhōngxīn èr lóu (zuò de xià sānshí ge rén)
Zěnme zuò: Yí ge wàiguó xuéshēng gēn yí ge Táiwān xuéshēng yìqǐ liáotiān, dì yī ge xiǎoshí shuō Zhōngwén, dì èr ge xiǎoshí shuō wàiguó xuéshēng zìjǐ de yǔyán.
Fèiyòng: Miǎnfèi
Cānjiā: Qǐng xiān shàngwǎng liúyán, xiě xià nǐ de míngzi hé diànhuà. Jiàoshì zuò mǎn le jiù bù néng zài cānjiā
Huáyǔwén zhōngxīn 11/20
text.english:
Want more practice speaking Chinese? Want to make Taiwanese friends?
Time: every Wednesday in December, 6:30–8:30 p.m.
Room: Chinese Language Center, 2nd floor (seats 30)
How it works: a foreign student and a Taiwanese student chat together, speaking Chinese in the first hour and the foreign student's own language in the second.
Fee: free
To join: leave a message online first with your name and phone number. Once the room is full, no one else can join
Chinese Language Center, 11/20

prompt.traditional: 每次活動，外國學生說中文說多久？
prompt.simplified: 每次活动，外国学生说中文说多久？
prompt.pinyin: Měi cì huódòng, wàiguó xuéshēng shuō Zhōngwén shuō duō jiǔ?
prompt.english: In each session, how long does the foreign student speak Chinese?

questions.why: A session runs 18:30–20:30 (two hours): Chinese in the first hour, the foreign student's language in the second, so one hour of Chinese.

prompt.traditional: 為什麼有的人可能不能參加？
prompt.simplified: 为什么有的人可能不能参加？
prompt.pinyin: Wèishénme yǒu de rén kěnéng bù néng cānjiā?
prompt.english: Why might some people be unable to join?

choices.pinyin: Jiàoshì zhǐ néng zuò sānshí rén.
choices.english: The room only holds thirty people.

questions.why: The room 坐得下30個人, and 教室坐滿了就不能再參加: once the 30 seats are taken, nobody else can join. The activity is free for everyone, it runs in December (11/20 is only the notice's date), and it is for Taiwanese and foreign students together.

text.traditional:
美心：
妳不是說今天下午要去圖書館嗎？可以幫我把桌上那兩本書還了嗎？還有，圖書館三樓有一本日本歷史的書，我上網查過了，現在還沒有人借，請妳幫我借回來。我今天上課上到晚上八點，回來以後請妳吃東西。謝謝！
可欣 星期二早上
text.simplified:
美心：
你不是说今天下午要去图书馆吗？可以帮我把桌上那两本书还了吗？还有，图书馆三楼有一本日本历史的书，我上网查过了，现在还没有人借，请你帮我借回来。我今天上课上到晚上八点，回来以后请你吃东西。谢谢！
可欣 星期二早上
text.pinyin:
Měixīn:
Nǐ bú shì shuō jīntiān xiàwǔ yào qù túshūguǎn ma? Kěyǐ bāng wǒ bǎ zhuō shàng nà liǎng běn shū huán le ma? Hái yǒu, túshūguǎn sān lóu yǒu yì běn Rìběn lìshǐ de shū, wǒ shàngwǎng chá guo le, xiànzài hái méi yǒu rén jiè, qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ jiè huílái. Wǒ jīntiān shàngkè shàng dào wǎnshàng bā diǎn, huílái yǐhòu qǐng nǐ chī dōngxi. Xièxie!
Kěxīn, xīngqí'èr zǎoshàng
text.english:
Meixin,
Didn't you say you're going to the library this afternoon? Could you return the two books on my desk for me? Also, there's a Japanese history book on the library's third floor; I checked online and nobody has borrowed it yet. Please borrow it for me. I have class until eight this evening. When I'm back, I'll treat you to something to eat. Thanks!
Kexin, Tuesday morning

prompt.traditional: 可欣請美心做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 可欣请美心做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Kěxīn qǐng Měixīn zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What does Kexin ask Meixin to do?

choices.pinyin: Tì tā shàngwǎng chá yì běn shū.
choices.english: Look a book up online for her.

choices.pinyin: Tì tā mǎi yì běn lìshǐ shū.
choices.english: Buy a history book for her.

choices.pinyin: Tì tā huán shū zài jiè shū.
choices.english: Return books and borrow one for her.

choices.pinyin: Xiàwǔ péi tā qù huán shū.
choices.english: Go with her to return books this afternoon.

questions.why: 妳不是說今天下午要去圖書館嗎？ reminds Meixin of her own plan; Kexin asks her to return two books and borrow the history book. Kexin already looked it up online herself, she wants it borrowed, not bought, and she is in class all day.

prompt.traditional: 可欣今天什麼時候會回來？
prompt.simplified: 可欣今天什么时候会回来？
prompt.pinyin: Kěxīn jīntiān shénme shíhòu huì huílái?
prompt.english: When will Kexin come back today?

questions.why: 上課上到晚上八點: her classes run until eight, so she gets back after eight. The library this afternoon is Meixin's errand, not hers.

passage.traditional: 期末考快到了，這個星期我每天都在圖書館念書，常常念{1}晚上十點才回宿舍。昨天回到房間，我發現室友已經把房間打掃得{2}的，還在桌上放了一個三明治。我問她：「妳今天{3}對我這麼好？」她笑著說：「看妳這麼累，想讓妳輕鬆一下。」可是我太累了，什麼都不想吃。我想把三明治放進冰箱，可是冰箱已經滿了，放{4}了，只好把它放在桌上，{5}就去洗澡、睡覺了。
passage.simplified: 期末考快到了，这个星期我每天都在图书馆念书，常常念{1}晚上十点才回宿舍。昨天回到房间，我发现室友已经把房间打扫得{2}的，还在桌上放了一个三明治。我问她：「你今天{3}对我这么好？」她笑着说：「看你这么累，想让你轻松一下。」可是我太累了，什么都不想吃。我想把三明治放进冰箱，可是冰箱已经满了，放{4}了，只好把它放在桌上，{5}就去洗澡、睡觉了。
passage.pinyin: Qímòkǎo kuài dào le, zhège xīngqí wǒ měi tiān dōu zài túshūguǎn niànshū, chángcháng niàn dào wǎnshàng shí diǎn cái huí sùshè. Zuótiān huí dào fángjiān, wǒ fāxiàn shìyǒu yǐjīng bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo de gāngānjìngjìng de, hái zài zhuō shàng fàng le yí ge sānmíngzhì. Wǒ wèn tā: “Nǐ jīntiān zěnme duì wǒ zhème hǎo?” Tā xiào zhe shuō: “Kàn nǐ zhème lèi, xiǎng ràng nǐ qīngsōng yíxià.” Kěshì wǒ tài lèi le, shénme dōu bù xiǎng chī. Wǒ xiǎng bǎ sānmíngzhì fàng jìn bīngxiāng, kěshì bīngxiāng yǐjīng mǎn le, fàng bú xià le, zhǐhǎo bǎ tā fàng zài zhuō shàng, ránhòu jiù qù xǐzǎo, shuìjiào le.
passage.english: Finals are coming. This week I've studied in the library every day, often until ten at night before going back to the dorm. Yesterday when I got back, I found my roommate had cleaned the room spotless and put a sandwich on the desk. I asked her, “How come you're so nice to me today?” She smiled: “You look so tired. I wanted to let you relax a bit.” But I was too tired to want anything. I wanted to put the sandwich in the fridge, but the fridge was already full and there was no room, so I left it on the desk and then took a shower and went to bed.

questions.why: 念到晚上十點: V到 + a time says how long the studying went on. 念完 would need what was finished, and 念在／念給 don't take a time.
Cleaning (打掃) leaves a room 乾乾淨淨的, spotless. A room is not left happy, lively or sweet-smelling by cleaning; those doubled words describe people, busy places and food.
怎麼這麼好？ shows surprise: how come you're so nice today? 什麼這麼, 那麼這麼 and 多少這麼 are not Chinese.
冰箱已經滿了，放不下了: the fridge is full, so there is no room for the sandwich. 放不起, 放不到 and 放不懂 don't say there is no space.
The writer leaves the sandwich on the desk, 然後 (and then) showers and goes to bed: one action after another. 因為, 雖然 and 要是 would need a reason, a contrast or a condition.

passage.traditional: 我的弟弟是小學生。他說話說得很好，可是漢字寫得{1}好，作文裡常常有錯字，讓他很煩惱。上個星期老師要他們寫一篇三百字的作文，他一直寫{2}晚上十一點。我說：「你{3}這麼晚還不睡？明天再寫吧！」他說明天就要交了。後來他把每個字都寫得{4}的，老師給了他很好的成績。他說以後{5}有不會寫的字，就要多查字典。
passage.simplified: 我的弟弟是小学生。他说话说得很好，可是汉字写得{1}好，作文里常常有错字，让他很烦恼。上个星期老师要他们写一篇三百字的作文，他一直写{2}晚上十一点。我说：「你{3}这么晚还不睡？明天再写吧！」他说明天就要交了。后来他把每个字都写得{4}的，老师给了他很好的成绩。他说以后{5}有不会写的字，就要多查字典。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ de dìdi shì xiǎoxuéshēng. Tā shuōhuà shuō de hěn hǎo, kěshì Hànzì xiě de bù zěnme hǎo, zuòwén lǐ chángcháng yǒu cuòzì, ràng tā hěn fánnǎo. Shàng ge xīngqí lǎoshī yào tāmen xiě yì piān sānbǎi zì de zuòwén, tā yìzhí xiě dào wǎnshàng shíyī diǎn. Wǒ shuō: “Nǐ zěnme zhème wǎn hái bú shuì? Míngtiān zài xiě ba!” Tā shuō míngtiān jiù yào jiāo le. Hòulái tā bǎ měi ge zì dōu xiě de qīngqīngchǔchǔ de, lǎoshī gěi le tā hěn hǎo de chéngjī. Tā shuō yǐhòu zhǐyào yǒu bú huì xiě de zì, jiù yào duō chá zìdiǎn.
passage.english: My younger brother is in primary school. He speaks well, but his characters aren't great, and his compositions often have wrong characters, which worries him. Last week the teacher had them write a 300-character composition, and he kept writing until eleven at night. I said, “How come you're still up so late? Write the rest tomorrow!” He said it was due tomorrow. In the end he wrote every character very clearly, and the teacher gave him a very good grade. He says that from now on, whenever there's a character he can't write, he'll look it up in the dictionary.

questions.why: 寫得不怎麼好: his characters are not very good (note the 錯字). Only 不怎麼 goes before a state verb like 好; 沒多少 counts an amount, 很少 says how often, and 沒什麼 goes before a noun.
一直寫到晚上十一點: he kept writing until eleven at night. 寫完／寫好 can't take a time, and 寫給 needs a person.
怎麼這麼晚還不睡？ shows surprise that he is still up so late. The other question words cannot go before 這麼 + a state verb.
Characters written so well that the grade is good are 清清楚楚的, very clear. Happy, lively and sweet-smelling don't describe handwriting.
只要……就……: whenever (as long as) there is a character he can't write, he will look it up. 雖然 needs 可是, 不但 needs 也／還, and 連 needs 都／也.

text.traditional: 我是從美國來的交換學生，在華語文中心學中文已經三個月了。老師每天都要我們用生字造句，還要我們用中文報告。我覺得最難的是聲調，因為以前在美國，我沒學過什麼聲調。有一次我去夜市吃牛肉麵，想跟老闆說「請多給我一點湯」，可是老闆笑著問我：「糖？吃麵要糖做什麼？」我回宿舍把這件事告訴一個台灣朋友，他說：「你說的不是『湯』，是『糖』啊！」後來，他每天晚上都陪我慢慢地練習。現在我說的中文好多了，連夜市的老闆都聽得懂了。
text.simplified: 我是从美国来的交换学生，在华语文中心学中文已经三个月了。老师每天都要我们用生字造句，还要我们用中文报告。我觉得最难的是声调，因为以前在美国，我没学过什么声调。有一次我去夜市吃牛肉面，想跟老板说「请多给我一点汤」，可是老板笑着问我：「糖？吃面要糖做什么？」我回宿舍把这件事告诉一个台湾朋友，他说：「你说的不是『汤』，是『糖』啊！」后来，他每天晚上都陪我慢慢地练习。现在我说的中文好多了，连夜市的老板都听得懂了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ shì cóng Měiguó lái de jiāohuàn xuéshēng, zài Huáyǔwén zhōngxīn xué Zhōngwén yǐjīng sān ge yuè le. Lǎoshī měi tiān dōu yào wǒmen yòng shēngzì zàojù, hái yào wǒmen yòng Zhōngwén bàogào. Wǒ juéde zuì nán de shì shēngdiào, yīnwèi yǐqián zài Měiguó, wǒ méi xué guo shénme shēngdiào. Yǒu yí cì wǒ qù yèshì chī niúròu miàn, xiǎng gēn lǎobǎn shuō “qǐng duō gěi wǒ yìdiǎn tāng”, kěshì lǎobǎn xiào zhe wèn wǒ: “Táng? Chī miàn yào táng zuò shénme?” Wǒ huí sùshè bǎ zhè jiàn shì gàosu yí ge Táiwān péngyǒu, tā shuō: “Nǐ shuō de bú shì ‘tāng’, shì ‘táng’ a!” Hòulái, tā měi tiān wǎnshàng dōu péi wǒ mànmàn de liànxí. Xiànzài wǒ shuō de Zhōngwén hǎo duō le, lián yèshì de lǎobǎn dōu tīng de dǒng le.
text.english: I'm an exchange student from the US, and I've been learning Chinese at the Chinese Language Center for three months. Every day the teacher has us make sentences with new words and give reports in Chinese. The hardest thing for me is the tones, because back in the US I hardly learned any tones. Once I went to the night market for beef noodles and wanted to ask the owner for “a little more soup (tāng), please”, but he laughed and asked me: “Sugar (táng)? What do you want sugar for with noodles?” Back at the dorm I told a Taiwanese friend, and he said: “You didn't say tāng, you said táng!” After that he practised with me slowly every evening. Now my Chinese is much better; even the night-market owner understands me.

prompt.traditional: 老闆為什麼問他吃麵要糖做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 老板为什么问他吃面要糖做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Lǎobǎn wèishénme wèn tā chī miàn yào táng zuò shénme?
prompt.english: Why did the owner ask what he wanted sugar for with noodles?

choices.pinyin: Tā shuō xiǎng chī tián yìdiǎn de.
choices.english: He said he wanted it sweeter.

choices.pinyin: Tā bǎ shēngdiào shuō cuò le.
Lǎobǎn de niúròu miàn shì tián de.
choices.english: The owner's beef noodles are sweet.

choices.pinyin: Lǎobǎn tīng bù dǒng tā de Yīngwén.
choices.english: The owner didn't understand his English.

questions.why: 湯 tāng and 糖 táng differ only in tone, and tones are his weak point: he wanted 湯 but said 糖 (你說的不是『湯』，是『糖』). He spoke Chinese, not English, and never asked for anything sweet.

prompt.traditional: 現在他說的中文怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 现在他说的中文怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Xiànzài tā shuō de Zhōngwén zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: How is his Chinese now?

choices.english: He still often gets tones wrong.

choices.pinyin: Shuō de bǐ péngyǒu hái hǎo.
choices.english: He speaks better than his friend.

choices.pinyin: Biérén tīng de dǒng tā de huà.

questions.why: 現在我說的中文好多了，連夜市的老闆都聽得懂了: others understand him now, not only his friend.

text.traditional: 上個學期我修了一門台灣歷史課。教授人很好，教法也很有意思，可是我那時候愛上了韓劇，每天晚上都看到半夜兩三點，上課的時候常常打瞌睡，教授說的話也沒記下來多少。有問題的時候，我只上網查一查。期末筆試的時候，有好幾題我都不會寫，就被當了。這學期我再修一次這門課。這次我每次上課都坐在最前面，把教授說的話好好地記下來，有不懂的地方就去辦公室問教授。有一天，教授說：「你最近上課很認真，跟上個學期不一樣了！」我想，這次我一定不會再被當了。
text.simplified: 上个学期我修了一门台湾历史课。教授人很好，教法也很有意思，可是我那时候爱上了韩剧，每天晚上都看到半夜两三点，上课的时候常常打瞌睡，教授说的话也没记下来多少。有问题的时候，我只上网查一查。期末笔试的时候，有好几题我都不会写，就被当了。这学期我再修一次这门课。这次我每次上课都坐在最前面，把教授说的话好好地记下来，有不懂的地方就去办公室问教授。有一天，教授说：「你最近上课很认真，跟上个学期不一样了！」我想，这次我一定不会再被当了。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge xuéqí wǒ xiū le yì mén Táiwān lìshǐ kè. Jiàoshòu rén hěn hǎo, jiàofǎ yě hěn yǒu yìsi, kěshì wǒ nà shíhòu ài shàng le hánjù, měi tiān wǎnshàng dōu kàn dào bànyè liǎng sān diǎn, shàngkè de shíhòu chángcháng dǎ kēshuì, jiàoshòu shuō de huà yě méi jì xiàlái duōshǎo. Yǒu wèntí de shíhòu, wǒ zhǐ shàngwǎng chá yì chá. Qímò bǐshì de shíhòu, yǒu hǎojǐ tí wǒ dōu bú huì xiě, jiù bèi dàng le. Zhè xuéqí wǒ zài xiū yí cì zhè mén kè. Zhè cì wǒ měi cì shàngkè dōu zuò zài zuì qiánmiàn, bǎ jiàoshòu shuō de huà hǎohǎo de jì xiàlái, yǒu bù dǒng de dìfāng jiù qù bàngōngshì wèn jiàoshòu. Yǒu yì tiān, jiàoshòu shuō: “Nǐ zuìjìn shàngkè hěn rènzhēn, gēn shàng ge xuéqí bù yíyàng le!” Wǒ xiǎng, zhè cì wǒ yídìng bú huì zài bèi dàng le.
text.english: Last semester I took a course on Taiwanese history. The professor was nice and taught in an interesting way, but I was hooked on Korean dramas then and watched until two or three every night. I often dozed off in class and didn't write down much of what the professor said. When I had questions, I only looked them up online. In the written final there were several questions I couldn't answer, and I failed. This semester I'm taking the course once more. This time I sit at the very front in every class, write down what the professor says properly, and go to the professor's office whenever I don't understand something. One day the professor said, “You've been very serious in class lately. You're different from last semester!” I think this time I surely won't fail again.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人上個學期上課的時候怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 写这篇文章的人上个学期上课的时候怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén shàng ge xuéqí shàngkè de shíhòu zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What was the writer like in class last semester?

choices.english: Sat at the very front and listened.

choices.pinyin: Měi cì dōu jì hěn duō.
choices.english: Took lots of notes every time.

questions.why: Watching dramas until two or three, the writer 常常打瞌睡 in class last semester. The dramas were watched at night, not in class, sitting at the front is this semester, and 沒記下來多少 means few notes, not many.

prompt.traditional: 這學期有不懂的地方，寫這篇文章的人怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 这学期有不懂的地方，写这篇文章的人怎么做？

prompt.english: This semester, what does the writer do when something is unclear?

choices.english: Looks for material in the library.

questions.why: This semester: 有不懂的地方就去辦公室問教授. Looking things up online is what the writer did last semester (只上網查一查).

text.traditional: 我是大學生，去年搬到學校附近的一個社區。這個社區很安全，大門旁邊還有很大的草地，天氣好的時候，鄰居常常帶家人在那裡野餐。我住的公寓在五樓，房東人很好，房租每個月八千塊，包括水費和網路，可是電費要自己付。簽約的時候，我還付了兩個月的押金。最方便的是，附近就有一家便利商店，只要走兩分鐘就到了。有時候我念書念到很晚，肚子餓了，就去買點東西吃。我覺得住在這裡很幸福。
text.simplified: 我是大学生，去年搬到学校附近的一个社区。这个社区很安全，大门旁边还有很大的草地，天气好的时候，邻居常常带家人在那里野餐。我住的公寓在五楼，房东人很好，房租每个月八千块，包括水费和网路，可是电费要自己付。签约的时候，我还付了两个月的押金。最方便的是，附近就有一家便利商店，只要走两分钟就到了。有时候我念书念到很晚，肚子饿了，就去买点东西吃。我觉得住在这里很幸福。
text.pinyin: Wǒ shì dàxuéshēng, qùnián bān dào xuéxiào fùjìn de yí ge shèqū. Zhège shèqū hěn ānquán, dàmén pángbiān hái yǒu hěn dà de cǎodì, tiānqì hǎo de shíhòu, línjū chángcháng dài jiārén zài nàlǐ yěcān. Wǒ zhù de gōngyù zài wǔ lóu, fángdōng rén hěn hǎo, fángzū měi ge yuè bāqiān kuài, bāokuò shuǐfèi hé wǎnglù, kěshì diànfèi yào zìjǐ fù. Qiānyuē de shíhòu, wǒ hái fù le liǎng ge yuè de yājīn. Zuì fāngbiàn de shì, fùjìn jiù yǒu yì jiā biànlì shāngdiàn, zhǐyào zǒu liǎng fēnzhōng jiù dào le. Yǒu shíhòu wǒ niànshū niàn dào hěn wǎn, dùzi è le, jiù qù mǎi diǎn dōngxi chī. Wǒ juéde zhù zài zhèlǐ hěn xìngfú.
text.english: I'm a university student. Last year I moved to a community near the school. It's very safe, and next to the main gate there's a big lawn where the neighbours often picnic with their families when the weather is good. My apartment is on the fifth floor. The landlord is nice; the rent is NT$8,000 a month, including water and internet, but I pay the electricity myself. When I signed the lease, I also paid two months' deposit. Best of all, there's a convenience store nearby, just a two-minute walk away. Sometimes when I study late and get hungry, I go and buy something to eat. I feel very happy living here.

prompt.traditional: 這個人每個月除了房租，還要付什麼？
prompt.simplified: 这个人每个月除了房租，还要付什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zhège rén měi ge yuè chúle fángzū, hái yào fù shénme?
prompt.english: Besides the rent, what does this person pay every month?

questions.why: Water and internet are included in the rent (包括), and the deposit was paid once, at signing. Each month only electricity is extra (電費要自己付).

prompt.traditional: 天氣好的時候，鄰居常在草地上做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 天气好的时候，邻居常在草地上做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Tiānqì hǎo de shíhòu, línjū cháng zài cǎodì shàng zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What do the neighbours often do on the lawn in good weather?

choices.english: Lie on it and look at the stars.

questions.why: 鄰居常常帶家人在那裡野餐: a picnic is eating together outdoors. The passage never mentions ball games, camping or stargazing.

prompt.traditional: 那家便利商店怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 那家便利商店怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nà jiā biànlì shāngdiàn zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What is true of that convenience store?

choices.english: It is next to the school.
It is next to the community's main gate.

choices.pinyin: Yào zuò chē cái néng dào.

text.traditional: 上個月，我跟兩個朋友去花蓮玩了三天。我們本來想開車走蘇花公路，可是聽說最近常有石頭掉下來，只好坐火車去。我們趁平日人少的時候去，所以民宿不貴，一個人一個晚上才八百塊，還有免費的無線網路。民宿離火車站不遠，走路十分鐘就到了。第一天我們去國家公園，山上的風景美極了，我還買了幾張明信片寄給家人。晚上我們去逛夜市，那裡的小吃又便宜又好吃，我們一下子就把帶去的錢花光了。民宿的錢是朋友先付的。回台北以前，我用信用卡買了好幾包當地的名產，送給沒去的同學。

text.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè, wǒ gēn liǎng ge péngyǒu qù Huālián wán le sān tiān. Wǒmen běnlái xiǎng kāichē zǒu Sūhuā gōnglù, kěshì tīngshuō zuìjìn cháng yǒu shítou diào xiàlái, zhǐhǎo zuò huǒchē qù. Wǒmen chèn píngrì rén shǎo de shíhòu qù, suǒyǐ mínsù bú guì, yí ge rén yí ge wǎnshàng cái bābǎi kuài, hái yǒu miǎnfèi de wúxiàn wǎnglù. Mínsù lí huǒchēzhàn bù yuǎn, zǒulù shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le. Dì yī tiān wǒmen qù guójiā gōngyuán, shān shàng de fēngjǐng měi jíle, wǒ hái mǎi le jǐ zhāng míngxìnpiàn jì gěi jiārén. Wǎnshàng wǒmen qù guàng yèshì, nàlǐ de xiǎochī yòu piányí yòu hǎochī, wǒmen yíxiàzi jiù bǎ dài qù de qián huā guāng le. Mínsù de qián shì péngyǒu xiān fù de. Huí Táiběi yǐqián, wǒ yòng xìnyòngkǎ mǎi le hǎojǐ bāo dāngdì de míngchǎn, sòng gěi méi qù de tóngxué.
text.english: Last month, two friends and I spent three days in Hualien. We first wanted to drive the Suhua Highway, but we heard rocks had been falling recently, so we had to take the train. We went on weekdays, when there are fewer people, so the B&B was cheap: only NT$800 per person a night, with free Wi-Fi. The B&B wasn't far from the train station, a ten-minute walk. On the first day we went to the national park; the mountain scenery was beautiful, and I bought a few postcards to mail to my family. In the evening we strolled the night market, where the food was cheap and tasty, and in no time we had spent all the cash we brought. A friend paid for the B&B first. Before going back to Taipei, I bought several bags of local specialties with my credit card for classmates who hadn't come.
